amendments.note: Analysis correction (not a protocol change). Pre-registration section 5 specifies within-seed intervals over paired game indices and short - control against fixed opponents on the same games. The first analysis code computed that difference with an unpaired (independent-error) interval. Corrected to per-game paired differences after the head-to-head and fixed-opponent results had been seen. Both versions are reported. With the unpaired interval, seed 1 pooled fixed-opponent G100 is -0.356 +- 0.360 and the regression flag R would not be raised (outcome 6, inconclusive); with the protocol paired interval it is -0.356 +- 0.209 and R is raised in both seeds (outcome 5).
